title: Turning the Tables on Human World
summary: Even after Ye Fan beats the Little Peng King, the Feng Holy Lord's guests suspect he has healed. Divine Physician Wang Shen, who owes the Divine King Jiang Taixu, 'examines' him and publicly gives him fourteen days to live unless he gives up his cultivation, which Ye Fan announces he will do in order to draw his enemies out. At Wang Shen's clinic on the Soaring Dragon Land, the ruins of the Tianxuan Holy Land, Wang Shen shows an ancestor's 2,500-year-old record of an orphan girl identical to Nannan who lost her memory every full moon and never grew, labelled 'Divine Infant'. That night Nannan runs into the forbidden ruins after a wailing voice. She comes back with the Old Madman, now changed in appearance, who has refined her seven-coloured stone and restored some of her memories, and he agrees to come with them to the Holy Cliff to find the Xing Secret. On the road, Human World assassins hired by Zhao Fa's backers attack; Ye Fan beats their Four Symbols killing art with the Heavenly Court holy technique, and the last assassin kills himself rather than name the client.
